csv_project_name: DB for New Computer Solutions Hub Building
csv_scope_of_work: Western Oregon University ( WOU and/or Owner ) is seeking proposals from qualified professional design, management, and/or construction firms (each a Proposer ) to act as a design/build team through a competitive ONE OR TWO-STEP Request for Proposals ( RFP ) process as described in this solicitation to retain one (1) firm to provide professional design, management and construction services for the new Computer Solutions Hub building ( project ). The Computer Solutions Hub project (est. 17,000-30,000 sf) will be a new construction building on the WOU campus located on the previous site of the now demolished modular classrooms ( MOD ). This new project will replace our current server space in a 60-year-old masonry building that s been reconfigured. The reconfigured area suffers from inadequate heating and cooling, dust mitigation, inadequate security and is vulnerable to seismic events.
